edits.old: the first half of the string consists of only the character c (i.e. s_1=s_2=...=s_{n/2}=c)
edits.new: the first half of the string consists of only the character c+1 (i.e. s_1=s_2=...=s_{n/2}=c+1)

edits.old: the second half of the string consists of only the character c (i.e. s_{n/2 + 1}=s_{n/2 + 2}=...=s_n=c)
edits.new: the second half of the string consists of only the character c+1 (i.e. s_{n/2 + 1}=s_{n/2 + 2}=...=s_n=c+1)
For example, "bbcc" is 'a'-good: the first half is all 'b', and "cc" is 'b'-good. Also "ff" is 'e'-good. The length-one base case is unchanged.

region_edits.after: Another example is "ddccbbbb". It is 'a'-good because the right half "bbbb" is constant 'b' and the left half "ddcc" is 'b'-good: its right half is constant 'c' and "dd" is 'c'-good, ending in the unchanged 'd' base case.
